actual_lines.text: rdfs:comment "3GPP Technical Document - base class for all meeting documents"@en .
rdfs:comment "Change Request document that modifies a 3GPP specification (TS/TR). Includes CR, draftCR, and pCR types."@en .

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .
rdfs:comment "Specification(s) that this CR modifies. Cardinality 1..*: a single CR may amend more than one Spec (e.g., paired stage-2 and stage-3 updates)."@en ;
